liveHeap.methodology: Seven fresh pages per runtime, runtime order rotated. Production build of existing matched-geometry comparison fixtures. Warm one complete 5,000-row lifetime before baseline; then measure another 5,000 mounted Frames/divs with active vertical layout, retaining fixture controls. Two full Chromium GCs before each reading, outside page JS jobs. Runtime.getHeapUsage usedSize delta; JS heap only, not native/process memory. Includes fixture bookkeeping and React root/local state architecture overhead. Script: /tmp/framekit-react-heap.mjs.
